basic_profile.bio: Avid Dragon Ball fan from Houston, Texas. I work as an IT specialist at a local tech firm and love diving deep into the lore of anime, especially Dragon Ball. During my free time, I enjoy exploring mods for games like Unturned and RedM. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Single and enjoy hanging out with my friends who share similar interests in gaming and anime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been a tech enthusiast since high school. My knowledge of anime comes from years of watching and participating in online discussions, as well as collecting manga and anime series. I've taught myself a lot about game modding, especially in sandbox and open-world games.
